approved_increase.notes: Stanger/Ballito. PROPOSED 10% effective 1 July 2026. Recheck 2026-07-05: final 2026/27 budget ADOPTED 29 May 2026 with the electricity hike 'confirmed' (North Coast Courier, 3 June 2026) and the property rates increase cut from 6% to 3% — but the exact FINAL electricity percentage was not literally verifiable, so this stays at the proposed 10% until confirmed. (The 9.8% seen in one article is the average total household bill increase, not the electricity line.)
